command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $root="$env:LOCALAPPDATA\ChatGPTMcpClean"; Write-Output '=== MCP LOG CANDIDATES ==='; Get-ChildItem $root -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object {$_.Length -lt 200MB -and ($_.Name -match 'audit|transport|receipt|log|observation')} | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 40 FullName,Length,LastWriteTime | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 320; Write-Output '=== EXACT TIME HITS ==='; $targets=@('2026-09-06T14:43','2026-09-06T14:44','2026-09-06T16:05','2026-09-06T16:06','2026-09-06T17:15','2026-09-06T17:16','2026-09-06T17:17'); $files=@("$root\.state\transport.jsonl","$root\.state\audit.jsonl","$root\.state\bootstrap-observations.jsonl"); foreach($f in $files){if(Test-Path $f){Write-Output "-- $f"; foreach($t in $targets){Select-String -Path $f -SimpleMatch $t | Select-Object -First 8 | ForEach-Object {$_.Line}}}}
